_comment: Real DLT record from the enu-biometric service, captured 2026-08-20. The second real sample, and the first with a payload. Class A (BusinessException [INDEX_MASTER_DATA_NOT_FOUND]). What this fixture pins, beyond the Phase 1 traps the first sample already covers: (1) the record KEY is the refId, and the same value appears in the payload at abisMWResponseNewSeda.refId -- Open Question 1, resolved; (2) the payload's top-level event_id (b733ab61) is a DIFFERENT uuid from the refId (c5d21184), so anything reaching for a field named event_id correlates to nothing; (3) __TypeId__ is EnrolmentEventResponse, not the EventMessage the first sample carried, from a different original topic and consumer group -- the single-payload-schema assumption in DLT_PLAN.md 5.3 is retired; (4) retry_topic-backoff-timestamp 01A0192B922D decodes to 2026-08-19T08:38:01.005Z, matching the TimestampedException instant in the trace to the millisecond, and sitting 43h after kafka_original-timestamp -- Trap 2 confirmed on a second sample; (5) the payload eventTimestamp 2026-08-17 19:07:47.552 is the same instant as kafka_original-timestamp 1786973867552 = 13:37:47.552Z, i.e. local +05:30 with no offset recorded. Never a log anchor.
